items.title: AI & the Death of Accuracy: What It Means for Zero-Trust
items.description: AI "model collapse," where LLMs over time train on more and more AI-generated data and become degraded as a result, can introduce inaccuracies, promulgate malicious activity, and impact PII protections.

items.title: Chinese Mustang Panda hackers deploy infostealers via CoolClient backdoor
items.description: The Chinese espionage threat group Mustang Panda has updated its CoolClient backdoor to a new variant that can steal login data from browsers and monitor the clipboard. [...]

items.title: Vibe-Coded 'Sicarii' Ransomware Can't Be Decrypted
items.description: A new ransomware strain that entered the scene last year has poorly designed code and an odd "Hebrew" identity that might be a false flag.

items.title: Critical Telnet Server Flaw Exposes Forgotten Attack Surface
items.description: While telnet is considered obsolete, the network protocol is still used by hundreds of thousands of legacy systems and IoT devices for remote access.

items.title: Microsoft Rushes Emergency Patch for Office Zero-Day
items.description: To exploit the vulnerability, an attacker would need either system access or be able to convince a user to open a malicious Office file.

items.title: WinRAR path traversal flaw still exploited by numerous hackers
items.description: Multiple threat actors, both state-sponsored and financially motivated, are exploiting the CVE-2025-8088 high-severity vulnerability in WinRAR for initial access and to deliver various malicious payloads. [...]

items.title: 'Stanley' Toolkit Turns Chrome Into Undetectable Phishing Vector
items.description: The malware-as-a-service kit enables malicious extensions to overlay pages on real websites without changing the visible URL, signaling a fresh challenge for enterprise security.
